items.text: We have uploaded and tested a new update for Ravva and the Phantom Library! This will fix a few issues we found and make some QOL changes. Please restart your Steam app if you did not get the update yet! To make sure you have the most recent version, check if you have the new Main Menu art:

Speedrun Mode now has a fixed seed.: Some details are random in the game, like the reward you get from some Item Containers. This would be a nightmare for speedrunners, so we decided to make a fixed seed! Now every time you play on Speedrun Mode, you'll have the exact same items and no surprises. Neat!

Star Coins added to every stage!: Now every stage has 2 Star Coins hidden somewhere, each giving you 100 coins as a reward! Use the Yellow summon to reveal them. They're not required to complete 100% of the game, but they're fun to hunt!
Ravva's Level 2 shot have a new look!: It was a bit hard to tell that Ravva got the first upgrade to their main shot, so we decided to modify its look!

Yellow summon now reveals secrets entrances!: Our little winged companion can reveal hidden items and fake blocks, but something was missing! Now, the sonar resonates with entrances to secret passages and you get a small indication in return. We hope that this makes the secret hunting more fun!
Completing 100% of the game now has a better indication on the World Map. No way to miss it!
Cutscenes now have a better indicator for skipping it. When you press a button, a bar will fill showing the time needed to complete the skip.
We added a missing jingle for when you finish the game on Speedrun Mode.
Pillarboxes resolution has been improved and now should work better on different resolutions (like Ultra Wide monitors and Steam Deck).

On Melvy and the Whale stage, we adjusted one of the "guts" platforms over the acid pool. Now if the player accidentally hits it and dies, the platform will be back when the player tries again (or if they leave the area).

That's all for the update! Thank you so much to everyone who played it and gave us feedback on your experience! We're now working on the Linux build and doing our best to give Linux players the best experience.
